brief: Hoo! Let’s step into the Middle Ages. Most children did not go to school. Many became apprentices. Build a master’s workshop, then take a photo for your teacher.
mapday: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read what each worker says and tap the job. Then finish two sentences about apprentices.
extra: Add a Wooden Barrel. Say what the master might keep in it.
step1: These are your four models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the Canvas tab.
step2: Put on your headset and open the On-Demand app. Click Explore, type today’s map in Filter environments, and click it. Then click Begin Solo.
step3: Press the top button on your right controller and click Models. Put the workbench by a building. Put the anvil, hammer and candle on or by the bench.
step4: Stand by the bench and say this out loud. An apprentice learns a trade by… In this shop, my job would be…
step5: Stand back so it all fits. Open your menu: Library, then Camera, then Take photo. Click the Canvas tab, pick this week’s VR assignment, and click Choose from My Files. Pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag. Then press the Meta button and click Quit.
